about: Where consumables come from when ForeverDB's data does not say, laid over it by _build/consumable_lists.py (where): what ForeverDB's data knows comes first, so an entry retires by itself once the data has the answer. The key is the consumable. One of sold, quest, drops or found says how its recipe is had, and container names what holds a consumable no recipe makes; read says where that was read. What players cannot get is under unobtainable, and is left out of the lists. Written by hand.
